decisions.reason: The original ios P2 baseline pixel coverage shows title, subtitle, notice, all six labels/details and unavailable reasons, the no-selection summary and collapsed disclosure, Request station and the complete footer. In this narrow enlarged text layout every required word continues into readable wrapped lines without ellipsis, hidden suffixes or clipped characters. Capture-edge cuts continue in overlapping originals. Unavailable breaks between characters because the unbroken word exceeds the narrow text width; all characters remain visible, as permitted by the brief.

Across the complete bound ios P2 baseline content sweep, header and notice, the six choice labels/details/reasons, summary, disclosure, primary action and footer occupy separate vertical/card regions. No text, status word, card content or action occludes another item. Viewport edge fragments are covered by adjacent original frames.
